scope: Getaway Barrel death trigger, public reveal and uniform random creature, random bottom remainder; schema158 public random-selection indication

oracle_facts.name: Getaway Barrel
oracle_facts.oracle_text: When this artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, reveal the top thirteen cards of your library. Put a random creature card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

obligations.permanent: Actual paid 3R artifact; trigger on actual battlefield-to-graveyard movement, using its last controller, including stolen source and graveyard replacement exclusion.
obligations.reveal: Reveal up to top13 to both players, preserving private cards below; no lookup/choice leaks.
obligations.random: Select one eligible creature uniformly using owned unbiased RNG, with no legal player-selected card, then put it onto battlefield. Empty/no-creature reveal puts none.
obligations.remainder: After the entry and its replacement choices, randomize the other revealed exact cards onto the library bottom; retain cards not in top13 in order. Chosen card is excluded even if its attempted move is prevented.
obligations.contracts: Deterministic RNG replay, exact references through entry suspension, hidden library boundary, wrong selection rejection and owned raw/index/restore including parent disposal.

history: Run1 naturally failed compilation on fixture comparisons between SharedVec and Vec and missing Snapshot borrow; fixed after termination.
Run2 compiled and two of three card tests passed; the remaining fixture wrongly excluded the globally legal Concede action. Corrected after termination.
Run3 passed all 29 tests; added an actual stolen-source last-controller library interaction, then run4 passed all 30.
validation.limitations: The prevented-selected-move rule is source-audited; no admitted live entry-prevention fixture exists in this focused suite.
validation.review: Preliminary independent source review found no gameplay defect; two final nonauthor reviews pending.
